description: One business that confirmed its facts at INITE, by its INITE slug (the name before .inite.ai) or its domain: what it does, how to reach it, its services with prices as confirmed, hours and whether it is open now, its locations, its company facts server (MCP and A2A) and whether it takes contact or booking requests from agents there. For which AI tool or app to use, call match_tools or atlas_lookup on the INITE Atlas, not this. Free, no account.
